    round_scores = case['round_scores']
    round_targets = case['round_targets']
    forced = case.get('forced', [])
    if not round_scores:
        raise ValueError('round_scores empty')
    num_tokens = len(round_scores[0])
    for scores in round_scores:
        if len(scores) != num_tokens:
            raise ValueError('inconsistent number of tokens')
    if len(round_targets) != len(round_scores):
        raise ValueError('round_targets length mismatch')
    active = set(range(num_tokens))
    forced_set = set(forced)
    if not forced_set.issubset(range(num_tokens)):
        raise ValueError('forced indices out of range')
    history = []
    for i, scores in enumerate(round_scores):
        target = round_targets[i]
        active_forced = active & forced_set
        if len(active_forced) > target:
            raise ValueError(f'round {i}: forced exceed target')
        num_to_select = target - len(active_forced)
        if num_to_select < 0:
            raise ValueError(f'round {i}: negative selection')
        candidates = sorted(active - forced_set)
        # rank by descending score, tie-break by index ascending
        candidates.sort(key=lambda idx: (-scores[idx], idx))
        selected = candidates[:num_to_select]
        retained_set = active_forced | set(selected)
        retained_list = sorted(retained_set)
        history.append(retained_list)
        active = retained_set
    retained_indices = sorted(active)
    return {'history': history, 'retained_indices': retained_indices}
"
